title: VXAce New computer, new problem: activating my VX Ace license

posts.author: Banana_Duck
posts.body:
I received a shiny new computer from my father, which means I have to download all my programs again (yay...), including RPG Maker VX Ace. However, despite inputting both my email address and my key, I got this error message:
My new computer runs on Windows 10 (64 bits).

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
check later or send a ticket of that problem as we cannot do much though.
it require customer service.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: Just make sure to enable some old internet protocols the registration window needs to be able to communicate with the publisher's servers. And contact the support team if it keeps failing.
